code.r:
# the join: one row per match (left = TRUE keeps the unmatched rows too)
joined = sites %>%
  st_join(bg, join = st_intersects, left = TRUE)

# the aggregate: sites per block group
counts = joined %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  group_by(geoid) %>%
  summarize(count = sum(!is.na(id)), .groups = "drop")

# block groups with no site at all
empty = sum(lengths(st_intersects(bg, sites)) == 0)
code.sql:
-- PostGIS: the join and the aggregate in one query
SELECT b.geoid, COUNT(s.id) AS count
FROM sites s
LEFT JOIN bg b
  ON ST_Intersects(s.geom, b.geom)
GROUP BY b.geoid;

FROM sites s
